_note: Single source of truth for chart benchmark overlays. categoryBenchmark maps an internal fund category to a passive index fund whose NAV proxies the SEBI category benchmark (no free daily index-level feed matches our NAV pipeline; Direct-Growth plans = lowest cost = closest to the pure index). Codes are pinned and verified at build time by scripts/verify_benchmarks.mjs. medianCategories maps cash-like categories (no meaningful single index) to a precomputed category-median series file key under public/category-median/.

Mid Cap.proxy: Motilal Oswal Nifty Midcap 150 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)

Small Cap.proxy: Motilal Oswal Nifty Smallcap 250 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)

Large & Mid Cap.proxy: Edelweiss Nifty Large Midcap 250 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)

Flexi Cap.proxy: Motilal Oswal Nifty 500 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)

ELSS.proxy: Motilal Oswal Nifty 500 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)

Multi Cap.proxy: Motilal Oswal Nifty 500 Index Fund (Direct, Growth)
Multi Cap.note: Broad-market proxy. The exact SEBI benchmark (Nifty 500 Multicap 50:25:25 TRI) has no index fund with meaningful history yet; Nifty 500 is used as the closest deep-history broad-market stand-in.
